Name: Superset Mobile
Tagline: Your coding agents, now in your pocket
Description: Orchestrate coding agents from your iPhone. Pick up the same workspaces from your computer, review diffs, and merge PRs away from your desk. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and other terminal agents. Included with Superset Pro. First month free with code MOBILELAUNCH.

Name: Jev
Tagline: Fast, structured AI decisions for software automation
Description: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One frontier model: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. Instead of generating text, Jev returns Choice, Score, and Noul answers with calibrated probabilities your code can act on. Parallel sampling delivers ~70-500ms responses, about 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than comparable LLM workflows, with output tokens free. Now available to everyone at console.typesafe.ai with no waitlist.

Name: Sai
Tagline: The autonomous computer fleet at your command
Description: Sai is the world's first robosecretary that works with a fleet of autonomous computers, doing your endless screen work. Each computer navigates software the way you do: reads the screen, clicks the button, types in the form. Trained to interact with the computer interface, Sai automates software even when they lack APIs: legacy desktop apps, internal portals, anything behind a login. Sai supports Windows, macOS and Linux. 73% on OSWorld.

Name: Arcjet
Tagline: Secure the AI agents you're building at runtime
Description: Arcjet is the runtime security platform that ships in your AI code. Detect prompt injection, authorize agent tool calls, redact sensitive data, and block bots and abuse. Real-time security building blocks you call inside your app, before an action happens.

Name: Google Flow for iOS & Android
Tagline: Google's AI creative studio now on mobile
Description: Transform ideas into reality using Google’s advanced generative models for cinematic video, images, & tools, right from your phone. Use direct camera roll and live camera uploads to ground your image and video generations in your own personal experiences. It’s now easier than ever to pull inspiration from your camera roll or photos and videos captured in the moment. And with cross-device project syncing, you take your creative work wherever you go.

Name: slop-grader
Tagline: Jev-AI CLI tool that evaluates text against custom rulesets
Description: slop-grader is a rule-based CLI tool that evaluates documents against custom rulesets and produces document scores and line-by-line flags to guide auto-fixing with an AI agent. Use it to catch AI filler in launch copy, to strip buzzwords from landing pages, score narrative flow in launch emails. Flagged lines let agents draft sharper copy. The tool flags outputs prompts so agents can draft fixes.

Name: Hyrax AI
Tagline: The AI architect for your entire codebase
Description: Code review tools tell you what’s wrong with a PR. Hyrax finds what should improve across your entire codebase and does the work. It builds deep context around your architecture and conventions, prioritizes issues across six engineering domains, writes each fix in context, verifies it against your tests and checks, and opens a GitHub PR for your team to review and merge.

Name: Turfs
Tagline: Keep content across your Mac organized in defined areas
Description: Use the desktop to keep content from across your Mac accessible and organized in defined areas — or simply keep it clutter-free. A turf can be backed by a real folder, a Finder tag, or your hand-picked selection of files and folders. Turfs stay put through Show Desktop; you choose what Mission Control does with them. Quit, and the desktop is exactly as it was. It replaces Finder's own desktop icon layer, so it can never be sandboxed or sold on the Mac App Store. $29 once, 10-day trial, no card.

Name: CC
Tagline: AI agent that helps keep your family in sync
Description: CC is Google Labs’ shared AI agent for families and households. Up to six people can each choose what to share, then CC keeps everyone aligned on the day ahead and takes care of the small logistical work that usually gets lost between inboxes.

Name: Cronhq
Tagline: Cron jobs that actually run
Topics: Open Source, SaaS, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: Cron jobs fail in silence. Two servers run the same crontab and your billing job fires twice. A job dies and nobody notices for weeks. Cronhq is a scheduler built around one guarantee: exactly-once execution, enforced by Postgres locks — not best-effort. Around it: retries with backoff, HMAC-signed webhooks, heartbeat monitors for jobs we don't run, and alerts that fire once on failure and once on recovery. Rust on Postgres. MIT-licensed, self-hostable, same image we run. Free tier: 5 jobs.

Name: AI Creative Insights by Decode
Tagline: Predict which ad wins before you spend on media
Description: Upload any ad, banner, OOH, or video creative and AI Creative Insights predicts how people will respond before your media budget goes live. Get attention heatmaps showing where eyes land first, second-by-second emotion curves, and prescriptive suggestions on what to change and why. Benchmark against category norms, compare variants side by side, and use Synthetic Audience to see predictions persona by persona. Built by Entropik, the team behind Decode.

Name: Sell to State
Tagline: Search 3M government contracts in 64 countries
Description: Structured government procurement data around the globe — tenders, suppliers and agencies. We help you research what governments around the world buy and find new opportunities to sell to them. No need to get a foreign company or e-signature before deciding there's money to be made. Browse for free; a flat fee unlocks the full dataset, saved searches, REST API and MCP.

Name: Lead Sparker
Tagline: Turn any brand URL into a ready-to-send insight deck
Description: Paste a lead's URL. The Oriane API watches and listens across Instagram and TikTok: untagged mentions, real earned reach, competitor playbooks, live trends. Get a deck in their brand colors, add your note and CTA, send the PDF. Free, no signup.

Name: Flicka
Tagline: Launch-ready product demos, from a Chrome extension
Description: A screen recorder that makes launch-ready demos: auto-zoom on your clicks, backdrops, frames, a webcam layer, MP4 export. A Chrome extension; nothing uploaded.Flicka is now a Chrome extension. Record a tab, your screen, a window, an area or your camera; draw and blur on the page while you record. Your clicks become zooms in the editor, with captions made on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

Name: Plume
Tagline: Import your old CV, get a polished ATS-ready one in minutes
Description: Plume is a free resume builder that turns your old CV (PDF, Word, even a photo) into a polished, ATS-ready resume in minutes. Pick from 43 templates, fine-tune fonts, colors and spacing, check your ATS score and fix issues in one click. Export pixel-perfect PDFs with no watermark, even on the free plan. Pro (€4.99/mo) adds an AI assistant that tailors your CV to each job offer.

Name: Gradio Workflow
Tagline: connect nodes to build AI pipelines, powered by Hugging Face
Topics: Productivity, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Create AI pipelines by connecting nodes. Bring together Hugging Face Spaces, models, datasets, and your own Python functions on a visual canvas - or let AI agents build workflows programmatically. Inspect intermediate inputs and outputs, and swap in better models without rebuilding your workflow. No downloads needed! Share with a URL or run via a REST API.

Name: PostSider
Tagline: Social media scheduling platform for humans and agents
Topics: Social Media, Marketing, GitHub, Social media marketing
Description: PostSider is a social media publishing platform built for humans and AI agents. Schedule and publish content across 30+ platforms from one place, or connect Claude, Codex, Cursor, or your own agent through MCP, REST API, or SDK. Manage your content calendar, analytics, teams, approvals, and automation without juggling multiple tools.

Name: AppGrowthKit
Tagline: Automate your App Store Screenshots and print money...
Description: AI App Store and Google Play screenshot maker. Device frames, AI layouts and copy, and store-ready export in one click - built for indie devs and teams.

Name: OmniDICOM
Tagline: DICOM viewing and metadata editing on Mac and Windows
Description: Open DICOM studies, edit metadata, and explore MPR, 3D volume rendering and cine on Mac and Windows. OmniDICOM includes PACS/DICOMweb transfer and exports; Professional adds stacked filters and analysis tools. A 14-day trial starts at first launch. Trial exports have limitations. Paid plans start at US$10/month per machine. For research and education, not diagnosis.

Name: Supacut
Tagline: Quickly turn interview footage into a rough cut
Description: Review hours of interview footage in minutes. Supacut helps documentary and interview editors find the strongest soundbites, organize material by theme, compare answers across interviews, and build a shortlist of selects. Or let Supacut analyze the material, propose narrative directions, and generate an editable rough cut. Export your work and keep editing in your NLE. Spend less time searching through footage and more time shaping the story.
